messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 -> serving-fleet: High error rate and repeated CUDA resets on shard group eu-west-1-gpu-2. Affected service: redwood-serving. PagerDuty triggered.
pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by sasha (on-call)
sasha: seeing alerts: multiple nodes in eu-west-1 showing `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION` then container restarts. Also seeing IB retransmit counters spike. Anyone on infra? :rotating_light:
dan: I'm on it, looking at IB counters and switch logs now. Initial read: massive retransmits + dup acks on 10.0.12.* fabric. Could be an external scheduler or a flaky NIC.
carla: runtime side: when retransmits spike, KV cache misses go up and multiple worker processes allocate extra GPU memory then OOM. We're seeing ~15% of requests fail with 5xx in the last 7m.
emily: question — did we just push the new RDMA driver config to eu-west earlier today? I saw a rollout to 3 node pools at 02:15 UTC.
alice: yep that rollout started 02:12 and completed 02:18. It was the fwk/ibv-2.4.1 -> 2.4.3 bump with aggressive RQ size defaults.
sasha: ok record that. dan, can you confirm if packet loss is local to a rack or widespread? also put a list of affected hosts in thread.
dan: looking. Preliminary: high retransmit counters concentrated on rack r13 (hosts: gpu-eu-13a, gpu-eu-13b, gpu-eu-13c). Switch logs show port flaps on TOR-13 for ~02:23-02:29. Running quick cluster query:

```
# rdma-monitor query --since 02:00 --filter rack=r13 --fields host,tx_retransmits,dup_acks
gpu-eu-13a  4200  180
gpu-eu-13b  3880  165
gpu-eu-13c  0     0   # momentary disconnect during flap
```

dan: also pulled kube events. Containers restarted on gpu-eu-13a/b due to OOMKilled around 02:24.

carla: sample runtime logs from gpu-eu-13a:

```
[02:23:57] runtime: kvcache: miss storm (burst=1200)
[02:24:01] worker-7: allocate 6.2GB for attention cache
[02:24:02] worker-3: CudaError: out of memory (allocation 512MB) -> process exit
```

emily: customer impact: we've flagged 4 paying tenants with >10% request errors and latency tail increased to ~2.8s p95 from 1.1s. Frontline notified.
alice: also saw autoscaler thrash — nodes coming up and pods rescheduling into the troubled rack makes it worse. We need to stop autoscale into r13.
sasha: agreed. mitigation plan (short): 1) cordon/drain affected rack nodes 2) temporarily disable RDMA on-serving pool for that rack or switch to TCP fallback 3) route traffic away from eu-west-1-gpu-2 capacity 4) rollback driver if we confirm it's causal.
dan: doing step 1 now: `kubectl cordon gpu-eu-13a gpu-eu-13b` then drain with `--ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` to avoid evict loop. Starting.

```
$ kubectl cordon gpu-eu-13a
node/gpu-eu-13a cordoned
$ kubectl drain gpu-eu-13a --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
evicting pod/redwood-serving-xxxx -> reschedule
```

infra-bot: drain job queued (job id 7732). Estimated time 90s.
dan: node gpu-eu-13c appears unreachable (IB lost), still showing as NotReady. Skipping.
carla: runtime: adding temporary model-fallback policy for affected customer routes: downscale to quantized-8bit variant and enable local-cache-only mode for 10m to reduce memory pressure.
emily: ramp traffic to dedicated reserved pools in other regions for impacted tenants — added traffic split rule to 80% eu-west-2, 20% eu-west-1 isolated hosts.
alice: autoscaler rules updated to avoid r13; also disabled nodepool rollout for fwk/ibv until postmortem.
sasha: dan, can you try disabling RDMA on one host (gpu-eu-13b) to see if TCP mitigates retransmits? Use the host control plane toggle.
dan: toggling RDMA -> TCP on gpu-eu-13b now (control-plane). Command:

```
$ infractl host-config set gpu-eu-13b network.transport=tcp --apply
applied host gpu-eu-13b: transport=tcp
```

dan: after switch, tx_retransmits on 13b dropped to 40 in next minute. Dup acks gone. cpu load on worker down.
carla: nice — we see fewer OOM events from the pods that landed on 13b after its network switch. Suggest expanding TCP fallback for the whole rack while we stabilize.
sasha: do it cautiously. dan, expand to gpu-eu-13a if 13c still flaky. Also open ticket to rollback driver if infra concludes driver upgrade contributed.
(10:06) pagerduty: sasha acknowledged, assigning to dan (infra) and carla (runtime) for remediation.
dan: rolling TCP fallback to r13 via host-config job (batch). Starting with 13a/13b; skipping 13c until it's reachable. Job id 7734.

```
infractl batch --hosts gpu-eu-13a,gpu-eu-13b set network.transport=tcp
started batch job 7734
```

(10:12) infra-bot: batch job 7734 completed: 13a/13b -> tcp. Telemetry: retransmit rate dropped 92% cluster-wide for r13.
emily: metrics update: error-rate for redwood-serving dropped from 14% -> 3% in impacted tenants. p95 latency back to ~1.3s. Still monitoring for residual 5xx from rescheduled pods.
sasha: good. customer comms draft: "We experienced a regional network degradation impacting GPU serving in eu-west-1 for approx 30 minutes; we migrated traffic and mitigated OOM resets. Root cause under investigation. We'll follow up." Carried by support.
alice: one more note — replay of infra telemetry shows the fwk/ibv 2.4.3 RQ defaults increased queues which may have amplified congestion under flap. Not conclusive but correlated.

carla: action items for post-incident: 1) full packet-capture + switch vendor logs for TOR-13 2) revert RQ default changes in driver on staging and bench 3) add autoscaler logic to avoid scheduling heavy work onto racks with rising retransmits 4) add early-warning alert on kvcache miss rate.
emily: customer impact summary: ~4 tenants with >10% errors, ~3200 requests failed, no data loss, best-effort mitigations restored service for most within 18m after page. Recommend proactive SLO credit offers for 2 customers.
sasha: assigning follow-up owners: dan -> infra investigation + driver rollback plan, carla -> runtime mitigations + autoscale change, alice -> rollout freeze & gating, emily -> customer impact ticket and comms. I'll run the postmortem. handing off to dan for remediation and will remain the incident lead.
dan: taking over. continuing investigation; will update thread every 15m or on new findings. If anyone notices fresh flaps re-alert here.
emily: thanks team. tagging support and legal for awareness. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated (partial). Current severity: SEV2. Next update due in 30m.
